# Nomadar and Fox Soccer Academy Management to Host Investor Webinar


13 Oct, 2026


|[Press Releases](https://investor.nomadar.com/category/press-releases/)


**Marshall, Texas, October 13, 2026** — Nomadar Corp. (“Nomadar” or the “Company”) (NASDAQ: NOMA), a Nasdaq-listed global sports, tourism, technology, and experiential infrastructure company, today announced it will host a virtual investor event on Wednesday, October 28, 2026, at 11:00 AM ET. The investor webinar (the “Webinar”) will feature a panel discussion with Nomadar CEO Americas & Board Director, Joaquin Martin, Fox Soccer Academy (“FSA”) Co-Founder, Managing Partner, and Technical Director, Christian Fuchs, and FSA’s Co-Founder, Managing Partner, and Business Director, Raluca Gold-Fuchs.


The Webinar follows Nomadar’s and FSA’s recent announcement of the signing of a definitive agreement whereby Nomadar will acquire a majority interest in FSA (the “Acquisition”). The Acquisition is expected to close in November, subject to the satisfaction of customary closing conditions. FSA is an international youth soccer organization that operates academies across the United States, the United Kingdom, and Austria, providing structured development programs, camps, clinics, showcase events, and international pathways for youth players.


The panel discussion is expected to address, among other topics, Nomadar’s strategic rationale for the Acquisition, the Company’s plans for the global expansion of its player-development model, the evolving landscape of U.S. youth soccer development, economics of the youth-soccer market, and Nomadar’s broader plans for building an international sports platform.


Interested parties can register for the Webinar at[Nomadar Live Webinar](https://us06web.zoom.us/webinar/register/WN_BxDpF2sMTXqjR5ulwMd68w) . Attendees will be able to submit questions during the Webinar that may be addressed during a Q&A session that follows the panel discussion. A replay of the Webinar will be available on the Investor Relations section of the Company’s website following the event.


**About Nomadar Corp.**


Nomadar Corp. is a Nasdaq-listed company operating at the intersection of sports, tourism, technology, health and experiential infrastructure. The Company develops and operates platforms designed to connect global audiences through high-performance training, youth development, digital education, international programs, sports tourism and large-scale experiential projects.


**About Fox Soccer Academy**


Fox Soccer Academy is an international youth soccer organization co-founded by Christian Fuchs, a former Premier League champion with Leicester City FC, and Raluca Gold-Fuchs. The academy operates across the United States, the United Kingdom and Austria, providing structured development programs, camps, clinics, showcase events and international pathways for youth players. FSA’s model combines elite coaching standards, a Premier League-inspired curriculum and a long-term approach to player and personal development.
